## Parent

#107

Spec: `spec/107-title-slots.md` (Shared by every menu Screen, The caption look, The title)

## What to build
- `scenes/ui/menu/menu_background.tscn`: `start_background.png` at its Stage rect.
- `scenes/ui/menu/menu_back.tscn`: the "Back" caption (`MENU[26]`) and its flat hit Button, as separate pieces.
- The `MenuCaption` Theme type variation in `scenes/ui/project_theme.tres`: bold font, white, a black outline for the Glow and a shadow offset for the DropShadow. Choose the outline size and shadow offset by eye against `dev/source_files/exported_assets/frames/46.png`, and record both in the Theme.
- `scenes/ui/menu/title_panel.tscn` (`mainMenu`, frame 46): the logo, "PLAY", "Game Manual" and "Credits" as Labels in a `FloatBox` column of fixed-height slots (pitches 61 and 90 px), each with its hit Button. Game Manual and Credits emit a signal and are not wired.
- `main_menu.gd`: the game opens on the title, Play shows the choice, and Back goes to the title from every panel (choice, slot list, name, class, options).
- Widen ADR 0002 to "branding and every link to the publisher's site" with the `documentation-and-adrs` skill. The title has no "Play More Games!", no "Play the Original Sonny" and no Armor Games logo.
- Add the new scenes to the rect record, and add the `chrome` entry for frame 46 to the compare tool.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The game starts on the title. Play shows the choice. Back from each panel shows the title.
- [ ] Every piece is under 0.5 px from the SWF in the rect test, and each Label's size and color match the record.
- [ ] ADR 0002 is widened.
- [ ] The compare tool scores frame 46 under its bar, and the 20 px shifted reference scores over it.
- [ ] The control moves one hit button 20 px and the rect test fails. Breaking one Back target fails the Back test.
- [ ] `uv run gut` passes.

## Verification
`uv run gut test/integration/test_ui_scenes.gd`, `uv run gut test/unit/test_screen_rects.gd`, then `uv run gut`. Run the compare tool's frame 46 entry.
